manual_steps: Entry filters to confirm (checked once at entry): is identified (has an email address on the profile); anonymous checkout_started events cannot enter; has not done order_completed in the 1 hour(s) after checkout_started; not in the program-wide global holdout (bucket of md5(user_id || ':lmm_global') under 5); the trigger is the person's own activity in the last day (a checkout, a product view, an order), which counts as engagement; anyone with no click, reply, order or session in 365 days is still excluded

Suppressions on every step: unsubscribed from marketing email, or hard bounced; marked any message as spam (complaint), ever; sunset-suppressed (lcm_sunset is true); only a fresh opt-in lifts it; internal, test and seed addresses; currently in a higher-priority flow (by the frequency policy's flow_priority: billing, cart, post-purchase first)
Before going live: send every message to a seed list, run `lcm simulate` on flow_spec.json, and get approval
